question: What are your opening hours?
answer: TechZone Computers is open from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Monday to Saturday. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays.

question: Are you open on Sundays?
answer: No, TechZone Computers is closed on Sundays and public holidays. We are open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

question: Where is TechZone Computers located?
answer: We are located at No. 45, Galle Road, Colombo 03, on the ground floor of the Galle Road Tech Centre.

question: What is your phone number?
answer: You can call TechZone Computers on +94 11 234 5678 during our opening hours.

question: Do you have a WhatsApp number?
answer: Yes, you can message us on WhatsApp at +94 77 123 4567.

question: What is your website?
answer: Our website is www.techzonecomputers.lk, where you can browse products and check prices.

question: Who founded TechZone Computers?
answer: TechZone Computers was founded in 2015 by Nimal Perera.

question: Do you repair laptops?
answer: Yes, we repair all major laptop brands. Most repairs are completed within 2 to 3 working days.

question: How much does a repair diagnosis cost?
answer: Diagnosis is free at TechZone Computers. We only charge if you approve the repair.

question: How long does a laptop screen replacement take?
answer: If the screen is in stock, we can replace it on the same day. Otherwise it takes 3 to 5 working days.

question: How much does a laptop battery replacement cost?
answer: Laptop battery replacements start from LKR 8,000, depending on the model.

question: Can you remove viruses from my computer?
answer: Yes, our virus removal service costs LKR 2,500 and is usually completed on the same day.

question: Do you install Windows?
answer: Yes, Windows installation with all drivers costs LKR 3,000. A genuine Windows licence is sold separately.

question: Do you offer data recovery?
answer: Yes, we offer data recovery starting from LKR 5,000, depending on the damage to the drive.

question: Do you repair MacBooks?
answer: Yes, we repair MacBooks. We have an Apple-trained technician on our team.

question: Do you repair mobile phones?
answer: No, TechZone Computers specialises in computers, laptops and printers only. We do not repair mobile phones.

question: Do you offer laptop cleaning?
answer: Yes, our internal cleaning and thermal paste replacement service costs LKR 3,500 and helps stop overheating.

question: Can you upgrade my RAM or SSD?
answer: Yes, and installation is free when you buy the RAM or SSD from TechZone Computers.

question: What warranty do you give on repairs?
answer: All repairs come with a 3-month warranty on both parts and labour.

question: What warranty comes with a new laptop?
answer: New laptops come with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. You can add a 2-year TechZone extended warranty for LKR 15,000.

question: Which laptop brands do you sell?
answer: We sell Dell, HP, Lenovo, ASUS, Acer and Apple MacBook laptops.

question: What is the cheapest laptop you sell?
answer: Our entry-level laptops start from LKR 150,000.

question: Which laptop do you recommend for students?
answer: For students we recommend the Lenovo IdeaPad or HP 15 series. They are affordable and good for studying and assignments.

question: Do you sell refurbished laptops?
answer: Yes, we sell refurbished laptops, and they come with a 6-month TechZone warranty.

question: Can you build a custom gaming PC?
answer: Yes, we build custom gaming PCs within 5 working days, and assembly is free.

question: Do you sell printers and ink?
answer: Yes, we sell HP, Canon and Epson printers along with original ink cartridges.

question: What accessories do you sell?
answer: We sell keyboards, mice, headsets, laptop bags, monitors, cables and external hard drives.

question: Do you give student discounts?
answer: Yes, students get 10% off laptops and accessories when they show a valid student ID.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept cash, Visa and Mastercard, and bank transfers.

question: Do you have installment plans?
answer: Yes, we offer 0% installment plans for up to 12 months with selected bank credit cards.

question: Do you deliver?
answer: Yes, delivery is free within Colombo for orders above LKR 50,000. Island-wide delivery takes 3 working days and costs LKR 1,500.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return unopened products within 7 days with the original receipt.

question: Can I trade in my old laptop?
answer: Yes, you can trade in your old laptop for credit towards a new one. We assess its value in store.

question: Do you price match?
answer: Yes, we match the price of any authorised retailer in Colombo for the same item in stock.

question: Do you have a loyalty program?
answer: Yes, TechZone Rewards gives you 1 point for every LKR 1,000 spent. 100 points can be exchanged for a LKR 1,000 voucher.

question: Can I pre-order a laptop?
answer: Yes, you can pre-order with a 20% deposit, and we will contact you when it arrives.

question: How can I check the status of my repair?
answer: Call us or send a WhatsApp message with your job number and we will give you an update.

question: Do you provide on-site support for businesses?
answer: Yes, on-site support within Colombo costs LKR 5,000 per visit. We also offer annual maintenance contracts for businesses.

question: Is there parking at the shop?
answer: Yes, there is free customer parking for 1 hour behind the shop.

question: Do you run any workshops?
answer: Yes, we run a free PC Basics workshop on the first Saturday of every month at 10:00 AM.
